title: Jax's client-side mods
description: A polished Fabric 1.21.1 client-side modpack packed with performance boosts, stunning visuals, and quality-of-life improvements. Compatible with any server — just install and play.
body:
# Jax's Client Side Mods
A sleek, performance-focused Fabric client modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1. No gameplay changes, no server requirements — just a smoother, prettier, and more polished Minecraft experience from the moment you launch.

## ⚡ Performance
**Mods:** **Sodium** · **Lithium** · **ImmediatelyFast** · **FerriteCore** · **ModernFix**
The foundation of this pack is built on the best optimization mods available. These work together to dramatically improve FPS, reduce memory usage, and slash load times so you spend less time waiting and more time playing.

## 🌄 Visuals & Shaders
**Mods:** **Iris** · **Distant Horizons** · **Continuity** · **Entity Model Features** · **Entity Texture Features** · **3D Skin Layers** · **Polytone**
Full shader support, render distances far beyond vanilla limits, connected textures, and refreshed mob and player visuals. Minecraft the way it was always meant to look.

## 🗺️ HUD & Navigation
**Mods:** **Xaero's Minimap** · **Xaero's World Map** · **Inventory HUD** · **AppleSkin** · **FPS Display** · **Advancement Plaques**
Stay informed and oriented at all times. Every stat, every location, every milestone — presented cleanly without cluttering your screen.

## 🎨 UI & Menus
**Mods:** **FancyMenu** · **Drippy Loading Screen** · **Seamless Loading Screen** · **Reimagined Intro**
Every screen gets the treatment it deserves, from the title menu to loading into a world. First impressions matter.

## 🎮 Quality of Life
**Mods:** **Just Zoom** · **Mouse Tweaks** · **Crafting Tweaks** · **Not Enough Animations** · **Eating Animation** · **Chat Heads** · **Chat Animation** · **Better Hand Bobbing** · **Smooth Scroll** · **JEI**
The small details that make a big difference. Every interaction feels more intentional, responsive, and satisfying.

## 🔊 Immersion
**Mods:** **Presence Footsteps** · **Melody** · **Picture Mode** · **ReplayMod**
Dynamic footstep sounds, full music control, clean screenshot capture, and session recording for your best moments.

## 🔌 Server Compatibility
**Mods:** **ViaFabricPlus** · **ViaVersion** · **ViaBackwards**
Connect to servers running older or newer versions of Minecraft without any hassle. Just join and play.
